scope: Pure CPU extraction with stubs of actual main methods; not DOM delivery, GPU correctness or native benchmark acceptance

checks.name: setup exception restores every temporary flag
context loss preserves fault pause and invalid result
explicit same-value play intent is preserved
input immediately before timeout is rejected without next RAF
local lamp brightness is represented in final signature
unchanged workload completes and restores original pause
raw user action epoch cancels even a no-value-change input
hidden page or renderer lock cannot produce a valid timeout result
fewer than two drawn frames is explicitly invalid
